- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:766 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new jq filter logic splits comment lines using `split("\n")` only, which fails to strip carriage returns (`\r`) when the comment body contains CRLF endings.
  WHY: The `v1` regex anchor `$` fails to match when a trailing `\r` remains on the line. Consequently, the gate logic fails to identify the latest pending-checks marker, leading to an incorrect `false` result (or an error if the header pattern match fails), causing the gate to run when it should skip.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:768 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `header_round` jq expression uses `capture()` on the entire comment body without verifying if the header pattern actually matches first.
  WHY: jq's `capture()` throws an error when the regex does not match the input. Since the filter is applied across all PR comments, any comment that does not start with the pending-checks header will cause this expression to error, which makes the entire `jq` filter return non-zero exit status, causing the gate to fail open (review dispatch runs when it should not).
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
